title: <run-dir>/<issue>/merge-record.json
description: Shape is normative here; semantics live in ../merge-record.md. `pr: 0` is the git-only null-coerced sentinel (FAFF-526) — a real PR number is otherwise always > 0. `integrity` is the corrective-artifact trust posture (FAFF-325/FAFF-373 pid-1 mount declaration) at merge time — a DIFFERENT concept from the FAFF-568 chain-anchor `integrity` leg documented in v0.2/anchor-integrity.md; the shared field name is coincidental.

pr.description: 0 is the git-only sentinel (no PR — FAFF-526); otherwise the real PR number

integrity.description: corrective-artifact trust posture recorded at merge time (FAFF-325/FAFF-373; writeMergeRecord defaults to 'unasserted' when the caller omits it) — not the FAFF-568 chain-anchor integrity leg. decideFloor's own gate states (unasserted-ok/unasserted-refuse) are the level-graded GATING decision this field's plain 'unasserted' feeds into — see bin/lib/merge-gate.js.
